established_findings.text: The Larkspur Data Center (Building 2) experienced a utility power loss at 02:14 on 14 March, resulting in a total outage of 4 hours 20 minutes and affecting 312 customers.
Building 2 houses four data halls with roughly 1,900 racks and opened in 2017.
Building 1 was not affected by the incident.
The outage was triggered by a storm that caused a transformer failure at Substation 7, as reported by the utility provider.
The UPS system was rated for 15 minutes at full load, but the batteries were exhausted after 9 minutes, leading to Generator B activation.
Generators A and B are each rated at 2 MW, with Generator B's tank holding roughly 11 hours of runtime at the start of the incident.
The incident generated 1,208 support tickets, with a median first-response time of 22 minutes.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: UPS duration reported as 15 minutes versus 9 minutes
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Additional technical logs confirming actual UPS runtime.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: Service restoration time reported as 06:34 versus 08:05
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Verification of service status logs at the specified times.

root_cause_statement: The root cause remains under investigation.
conclusion: The outage at Building 2 lasted 4 h 20 m, impacted 312 customers, and was caused by a storm‑induced transformer failure at Substation 7. While the UPS and generators performed as expected, conflicting reports on UPS runtime and service restoration times remain unresolved, and the root cause is still under investigation.
